title: Delete duplicated modem implementations
description:
Delete modem logic that becomes redundant after the BPSK and QPSK migration is complete. This task exists to enforce a single shared modem implementation rather than multiple compatibility-era implementations.

## Success Criteria

- [ ] Duplicated modem code paths are removed cleanly rather than deprecated.
- [ ] One coherent shared modem implementation remains as the source of truth for functionality.
- [ ] Custom or parallel modem implementations do not remain scattered across the codebase after cleanup.
- [ ] Legacy cleanup does not break the migrated public entry points.

## Notes

Do not add deprecation shims, compatibility aliases, or transitional duplicated logic here. The expected outcome is direct deletion of superseded modem code once the shared framework-backed path is in place.
